The issuer shows severe profitability stress with negative net income (-640M) and negative EBIT/operating income (-459M), indicating ongoing operating losses. Leverage is very high (shareholders’ equity of 415M versus total assets of 12,240M), which leaves little balance-sheet cushion despite a moderately healthy current ratio (4,976/2,796 ≈ 1.78). Overall, this profile aligns with a high likelihood of credit weakness.  
DECISION: CCC-
